sample_scope: All six previously outcome-selected cases; illustrative only
frame: Recorded LIDAR_TOP keyframe ego pose; x forward, y left, z up. Hypothetical robot centred at recorded ego origin.
geometry: Transform all eight oriented-box corners global to ego using full quaternion rotation; convex hull of XY projection; boundary-touch counts as intersection; no vertical exclusion.
alert: At least one eligible predicted footprint intersects corridor. GT reference uses all already SDK-filtered boxes.
object_diagnostic: Existing same-class descending-score greedy matching at global XY distance strictly below 2m. A zone GT is covered only if its assigned prediction also intersects zone.
limits: Static road-scene replay, not navigation, factory validation, free-space certification or stopping-distance calculation. Annotation absence does not prove free space. Existing SDK filters exclude some obstacles. No new inference. Sensitivity settings fixed before outcomes.
